items.title: EliseAI in talks to raise $300M at a $3.7B valuation
items.note: AI leasing and maintenance platform used by 70% of the 50 largest US rental operators; up from $2.2B a year ago

items.title: DeepSeek launches open-source Harness as a rival to Claude Code
items.note: Ships alongside official DeepSeek-V4-Pro tuned for agentic workloads, MIT-licensed on GitHub

items.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser runtime built for AI agents
items.note: Runs in V8 isolates on Workers, uses 3-7x less CPU/memory than Chromium, compatible with Puppeteer/Playwright/MCP

items.title: Missouri's new wholesaler disclosure law takes effect August 28
items.note: SB973 requires a 14-day written disclosure before an assignable contract; violations fall under the state's Merchandising Practices Act

items.title: CoStar closes $800M acquisition of Zonda
items.note: Adds new-home construction data and the NewHomeSource and Livabl marketplaces to CoStar's platform

items.title: Microsoft names Nati Amsterdam to lead its Israel operations
items.note: Nvidia Israel executive takes over as general manager starting in October
